name: Saudi Aramco CCC / SACS-002 Third Party Cybersecurity Standard
methodology: 100% compliance required. CCC = remote validation; CCC+ = on-site (for Network Connectivity / Critical Data Processor). Validity: 2 years. Derived from NIST CSF.

likelihood.label: Rare
likelihood.definition: May occur only in exceptional circumstances (<5% per year).

likelihood.label: Unlikely
likelihood.definition: Could occur but not expected (5-25% per year).

likelihood.label: Possible
likelihood.definition: Might occur at some time (25-50% per year).

likelihood.label: Likely
likelihood.definition: Will probably occur in most circumstances (50-75% per year).

likelihood.label: Almost Certain
likelihood.definition: Expected to occur in most circumstances (>75% per year).

impact.label: Insignificant
impact.definition: Negligible operational, financial, regulatory or reputational impact.

impact.label: Minor
impact.definition: Limited impact contained within a single team or system; recoverable in <1 day.

impact.label: Moderate
impact.definition: Notable impact on a business unit; recoverable in 1-7 days; minor regulatory attention.

impact.label: Major
impact.definition: Significant impact across multiple business units; >1 week to recover; regulatory action probable.

impact.label: Severe
impact.definition: Existential or systemic impact; loss of license, major fines, sustained customer loss.

maturity.label: Non-Existent
maturity.definition: No process or control in place.

maturity.label: Initial / Ad Hoc
maturity.definition: Process exists but is informal and inconsistent.

maturity.label: Repeatable
maturity.definition: Process is documented and repeated, but not standardized across the organization.

maturity.label: Defined
maturity.definition: Process is documented, standardized, and integrated across the organization.

maturity.label: Managed
maturity.definition: Process is measured, monitored with KPIs, and controlled.

maturity.label: Optimized
maturity.definition: Process is continuously improved through monitoring, metrics, and lessons learned.
